facts.value: The exchange programs of the department are advertised once a year. The application for a specific program or university follows the respective announcement on the internet.
Please refer to the respective announcement for information on application requirements and application documents.
There are separate application processes for European and global programs.
The announcement and selection for global programs occur before the selection for European programs.
If your application for a global program is unsuccessful, an application for the European exchange under the Erasmus+ program is possible without restrictions.
The announcements are published at the end of October with the application deadline of February 1 of the following year.
